subject: reasoning
question:
H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between V and I when counted from the right of V. Only three people sit between H and J when counted from the right of J. I sits to the immediate right of J. W sits to the immediate right of K.

Who sits fourth to the right of U?
solution:
• H, I, J, K, U,V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.
 
• Only two people sit between V and I when counted from the right of V.
 
• Only three people sit between H and J when counted from the right of J.
 
• I sits to the immediate right of J.
 
• W sits to the immediate right of K.

The final arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed881558538f054f5afa217a0831b3f54355d03bcf1457bb1ef61a60b616af61.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
